dcat_keyword_sm: Digital Data Information and Business Services Branch
dct_description_sm:
Towers — structures or buildings that are typically higher than their diameter and high relative to their surroundings — are shown in this data set.

They include:
  • communication towers
  • fire towers
  • microwave towers
  • radio towers
  • navigation beacons
  • lighthouses
  • lightning locators
  • meteorological towers
